title: Planted by the Water
question: What is the tree rooted in, and what makes it fruitful?
blurb: A picture of a rooted life. Trace where else Scripture plants that same tree.

nodes.content: What is the tree rooted in, and what makes it fruitful?

nodes.verseText: Blessed is the man who does not walk in the counsel of the wicked, or set foot on the path of sinners, or sit in the seat of mockers. But his delight is in the Law of the LORD, and on His law he meditates day and night. He is like a tree planted by streams of water, yielding its fruit in season, whose leaf does not wither, and who prospers in all he does.

But blessed is the man who trusts in the LORD, whose confidence is in Him. He is like a tree planted by the waters that sends out its roots toward the stream. It does not fear when the heat comes, and its leaves are always green. It does not worry in a year of drought, nor does it cease to produce fruit.
This Book of the Law must not depart from your mouth; meditate on it day and night, so that you may be careful to do everything written in it. For then you will prosper and succeed in all you do.
Therefore everyone who hears these words of Mine and acts on them is like a wise man who built his house on the rock.
rooted and built up in Him, established in the faith as you were taught, and overflowing with thankfulness.
